verdict.rationale: Better Stack documents one incident-triggered automation: posting a todo list when a new incident fires and routing it to the right responder. It also documents condition-based escalation rules (time, team availability, incident origin, metadata). That is a narrow slice of a workflow engine rather than a general automation builder. missing for 10: a documented general condition/action workflow engine, automated status updates, reminders, incident field changes, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an SRE, a condition-based workflow engine automates the toil — updates, reminders, field changes — triggered by incident events

citations.quote: Post a todo list when a new incident is triggered. Route the incident to the right responder.
Configure complex rules for escalating incidents based on time, team availability, and incident origin.
Attach business knowledge to all incidents for more granular reporting and escalation rules with catalog and metadata.
